tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 19 gsung 'bum/_tA ra nA tha/ （dpe bsdur ma/）

tei:div.tei:p: spyi rdzu sgri bsdu sgrig 'gan 'khur ba gtso bo//sne spren dkar thub bstan nyi ma/bsdu sgrig 'gan 'khur gzhon pa dang /gtso ga pa/karma bde legs/gtso sgrig gzhon pa/'gro 'dul rdo rje'/bsdu ga pa/mun sel/thub bstan nya ma/bstan 'dzin blo gros/zla ba bstan 'dzi///the/sa rab bzang po( phrizhu dag ༷ḍi dkaX chag ga mkhan/dpal spre de zhes rgya mtsho/phur pa na las/dkan mchag bsam gtan/thub bstan nya ma/bstan pa dar rgyas/par sgrig lag rtsal pa/tshe ring chos sgron/shes rab dpal g.yang /bsod nams 'brug rgyas/

〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 ces pa'i dpe tshogs 'di ni dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis bsgrigs shing 'di ga dpe skrun khang dang mnyam 'brel gyis bskrun pa'i dpe rnying dpe tshogs shig yin la/ de yang mkhas dbang gzan dkar rin po che thub bstan nyi ma mchog gis spyi'i gtso skyong gnang ste/ dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis nye ba'i lo bcu tsam gyi ring la 'bad brtson chen pos bod kyi sa gnas gang sar bzhugs pa'i bod yig dpe rnying po ti khrir longs pa rang byung dang mi'i gnod 'tshes 'jig la nye ba'i nyen yi las bskyabs te legs par bsgrigs shing dkar chag tu btab/ dpe thum gsol/ dpe sgrom bzhengs te srung skyob mdzad gnang ba dang gnang mus su yod pa ni/rang re'i mes po'i shul nor srung skyob rgyun 'dzin dang bod rig pa'i gal che'i dpyad gzhi mkho 'don gyi dgos pa che ba ma zad/ rang rgyal mi rigs rig gnas nor mdzod dar rgyas dang srung skyob bgyi ba'i 'phrin las gal chen zhig red/nye char dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang 'di ga dpe skrun khang gnyis zhib gros byas mthar/ srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog 〈bka' gdams dpe da rkani gces btus〉 zhes pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gyi dpe tshogs chen mo zhig mu mthud nas legs sgrig dang dpe skrun byed bzhin yod pa dang / da char yang dmigs yul dgos pa gcig gyur thog 〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 ces pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gal chen gyi dpe tshogs chen mo 'di nyid par skrun bya rgyu yin la/ de yang sngon byon mesapo mkhas dbang dam pa du mas shul du bzhug pa'i gsung 'bum dpe dkon gal chen rnams dang / 'thar 'thor du bzhugs pa'i dpe dkon gal chen dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus te bsgrigs pa 'di'i nang don thad la/ nang don rig pa dang / gso ba rig pa/ tshad ma rig pa/ sgra rig pa/ bzo rig pa/ lo rgyus/ rtsis rig sogs bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kun 'dus pa'i dpe dkon nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung lta bu zhig yin/ —1—

'a 'dra' dpe skrun mnyam las go skabs legs po nged cag dpe skrun khang la thob pa shan tu skal ba bzang zhing gzi brdzid kyi 'os 'gan zhig tu brtsis te lo 'ga'i dpe skrun 'char gzhi gtso bo'i nang du bkod zin cing / las gzhi 'di la krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid dang rgyal khab phyi nang gi bod rig pa'i mkhas dbang du mas gdeng 'jog dang mthong chen gyis skul ma yang thob/〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 gi ma phyi phal cher ni dbu med bris rnying sha stag yin pas/ ma dpe gsal mi gsal dang skung yig mang zhing bris tshugs 'dra min gyi dbang gis klog dka' ba'ang shin tu mang po 'dug 'on kyang dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis lo mang ring nyams myong bsdu len dang mkhas dbang du mar bka' 'dri zhus par brten yig gzugs gsar rgyag dang phyogs sgrig thub pa byung / par shing du 'khod yod pa rnams kyang dpe rnying g.yin pa dang bsdur te gtan la phab yod pa bcas te zhib cha deb so so'i bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du gzigs par zhu/dpe rnying srung skyob dang phyogs sgrig dpe skrun gyi las ka 'di la rgyab skyor dang thugs khur gnang mkhan gyi mkhas dbang rnams dang / lhag par du krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid lhan rgyas dang / mkhas dbang thub bstan nyi ma rin po che mchog sogs kyis rgyab skyor dang mdzub ston gyi bka' drin bskyangs pa la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang / dpal brtsegs zhib 'jug khang gi 'gan 'dzin pa lhan rgyas dang / zhu dag pa/ yig rgyag pa sogs mdor na las gzhi 'di la lhag bsam dang 'bad brtson chen pos zhabs phyi zhu mkhan rnams la snying thag pa nas bka' drin che zhes zhu rgyu dang /dpe tshogs 'di'i dpe sgrig dang zhu dag thad la ha cang nan tan dang zhib tshags bgyi khul byas mod/'on kyang nga tshor shes tshad dman pa'i dbang gis nor 'jug mi nyung ba yod srid pas dpyod ldan dag gis nor bcos yo bsrang gi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang bar zhu zhu/zhes krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas/spyi lo 2007lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes 10la/

de la 'dir rang cag kha ba can gyi zhing 'dir chos rgyal lo paṇa rnams dang / sa dge bka' rnying sogs kyi mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i dam pa'i skyes bu rnams kyis/ bshad sgrub kyi shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i chos brgyud dang bka' srol mtha' dag dang / de dang rjes su 'brel ba'i thun mong gi rig gnas sum rtags snyan ngag mngon brjod sdeb sbyor/ skar rtsis 'byung rtsis / sgra tshad bzo gso sogs mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs zab cing rgya che ba tshang la ma nor ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'chad nyan 'gyur gsum dang / bshad sgrub las gsum gyi sgo nas thog mar srol gtod/bar du gtan la phab/ rim bzhin dar rgyas btang ba sogs 'dzin skyong spel bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin bdag rkyen la brten nas/ dbus gtsang khams gsum du bzhugs so cog gi glegs bam thams cad gcig tu sbungs na ri rab lhun po'i gtos dang mnyam zhing / chos tshan gyi rnam dbye ji snyed yod pa grangs su bgrangs na nam mkha'i gza' skar tshogs kyang skyengs par byed pa zhig mchis pa tsam du ma zad / rgya bal hor sogs kyi yul gru kun tu'ang dar khyab che/da lta'i char bod rig pa'am bod kyi shes rig ces su grags pa 'di nyid 'dzam gling shar nub kyi yul gru dag tu'ang mched de/ dper na/ o ka si phor dhi dang / to wid lta bu yo rob dang / a— rdo digs su grags wo gyi slob grwa wo mo

rnams su bod yig gi dpe mdzod wo po yod par ma zad/ bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed sa'i sde tshan dang slob ma yang mi nyung ba yod/da ni gong du smras pa'i zugad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad ces pa de gang dang gang yin pa'i ngo sprod mdo tsam zhu na/ de yang ji skad du/ 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'i zhal nas/ chos blon thon mi be+e ro ska cog zhung / /gnubs chen rin bzang rngog lo sa skya pa/ /bu ston bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu// zhes dang / bod yul sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad/ /rnying ma bka' gdams lam 'bras bka' brgyud pa/ khangs pa zhi byed sbyor drug bsnyen sgrub bo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ shes bya'i gzhung lugs sna tshogs kyi 'gyur khyad dang 'chad tshul gyi dbye bas bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu dang / sgrub pa nyams su len tshul la brgyud pa'i khyad par dang man ngag gi dbye bas sgrub brgyud 'dren pa'i shing rta brgyad de/ bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho lta bu zhig bdag cag gi yab mes gong ma rnams kyis gces pa'i lus srog longs spyod thams cad phangs pa med par btang ste/ phyi rabs rang re'i brgyud 'dzin rnams la 'phran yun phan bde'i dpal la dmigs nas bzhag pa'i nor bu rin po che yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po mtha' yas pa zhig mchis/de dag las mang che ba rig gsar lo bcu'i god chag chen po sogs dus kyi rgud pa'i dbang gis sems med 'byung bzhi'i 'jig pa dang / sems ldan mi dang mi min gyi gnod pas nyams nyes chen por gyur pa ni rgya bod yongs grags ltar lags/ —2—

rig gnas gsar brje'i mjug sgril ba dang myongs cig tang gi yang dag pa'i srid jus kyi nyi 'od slar yang 'phros te/ tang dang rgyal khab kyis 'go khrid dang rtsa 'dzugs gnang nas/ dpe rnying 'thor bsdu dang / legs sgrig dpe skrun/ sgyur spel sogs kyi sgo nas rang rigs kyi rig gnas nyams pa sor chud dang / mi nyams gong 'phel gyi bya bar so so'i zhanas bstun gyi sri zhu sgrub pa'i skal ba bzang po'i dpal la longs su spyad du yod pa'i skabs 'dir/ rang re'i yab mes rnams kyis bzhag pa'i pha nor mang po zhig da dung yang nged cag gi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du lhag yod pa rnams la gces spras chen pos srung skyob dang dar spel byed rgyu ni mes rgyal gyis gnang ba'i las 'gan yin par ma zad/ 'u cag bod kyi rig gnas slob gso'i bya bar legs skyes 'bul mkhan gyi rgan dar 'bring gsum gyi shes yon can la mtshon na/ rang re'i phrag par bab pa'i gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i gzi 'od bla na 'bar ba'i 'os 'gan mchog tu gyur pa zhig kyang yin par sems/der brten/ phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis ljags rtsom gnang ba'i gsung rab/ bshad sgrub shing rta bco brgyad las grub pa'i mdo sngags kyi gzhung bshad dang / chos 'byung dang gdan rabs/ rnam thar dang gsan yig brda sprod dang snyan ngag /rtsis dang gso rig sogs dpe dkon 'thor ba rnams bsdus/ chad pa rnams bsab/ nyams pa rnams gsos/ zhakhru/gas pa rnams bsgrigs te dpe tshogs 'ga' rim pa bstar chags su par du bskrun pa dang bskrun rtsis las/—3—

da lan 'dir jo nang rje bcun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dpe bsdur ma 'di rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/'byung char nga tsho'i dpe tshogs dpar skrun zhu rgyu'i skor la lhag bsam ldan zhing mkhyen spyan yangs pa'i mkhas dbang rnams kyis dgongs 'char gyi bka' slob stsol gnang dang / dpe dkon gyi ma phyi g.yar gnang gi skyabs 'jug yong ba mkhu/na mkhra/na/ /zhor 'phros gsal 'debs zhu ba/ lhag par du da lta lus kyi lang tsho rgyas shing / sems kyi blo gros bkra ba'i gzhon skyes rnams snel mtshon na/ snying pos dben pa'i kha pho 'don pa las/ zol med kyi lhag bsam dkar po snying la 'chang / don ldan gyi rnam dkar bya ba dang du len/ lhad med kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed/ 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu'i las ka cung zad re sgrub nus na/mes rgyal la zhabs tog 'grub/ rang rigs la legs skyes 'bul/ rang nyid kyi la rgya mngon thub pa zhig kyang 'ong ba ni mthong chos mngon gyur lags pas/ de bzhin dgongs dbyings su chub par zhu kho/ /phran 'brog rgan 'khyams po thub bstan nyi mas/spyi lo 2007pa'i zla tshes la gus phul/—4—

bsdu sgrig gsal rnga'i nad/da lam nga tsho'i jo nang rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs te par skrun zhus pa 'di ni/ gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma'i bka' slob dang bdag rkyen 'og byung ba zhig yin/de yang spyir khong la gsung 'bum pod bzhi bcu tsam zhig yod tshul phyis su bris pa'i rnam thar 'ga' las gsal yang / dngos su pod bzhi bcu'i dkar chag kha gsal zhig da sngon nga tsho'i mjal rgyu ma byung / da lam dngos su mjal rgyu byung ba'i pod bco lnga ni/ deng sang yongs grags su rtag brtan par ma zhes 'bod pa 'di ni/ bod rab byung bcu pa'i me 'brug (spyi lo1616) la/ mnga' ris smad kyi gung thang gi rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'am/ yang lugs gcig la dmar po sde bsgrangs na nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa bsod nams dbang phyug sdes yon bdag byas/ tā ra nā tha'i dngos slob gnya' yi ban+di dkon mchog legs pas/ thog ma'i mtshams sbyor dang par byang 'bri ba sogs byas te/ dus 'khor sngags phreng dang skad gnyis shan sbyar sogs chos tshan bcu bzhi shing par du bkos pa/ rtag brtan dam chos gling du spyan drangs te bzhugs su gsol/ de'i steng du rtag brtan rang nas brkos pa bcas pod —1 —

bco lnga tsam zhig yod pa de'i bu dpe par ma tshar gcig /rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos 'bras sbungs dpe mdzod khang du gdan drangs ba/ phyis dus 'gyur skabs su pe cing mi rigs pho brang du bzhugs kyang / deng seng bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du spyan drangs te bzhugs pa de yin/yang gangs can mkhas grub rim byon gyi ming mdzod las/ khong la gsung rtsom shin tu mang po yod par grags kyang rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos/gsung 'bum shing par rnams bka' rgya btab ste par mi chog pa mdzad pas da lta khong gi gsung rtsom rnams kha tshang ba ha cang dka'/ rgyal dbang lnga pa zhing du gshegs rjes/ blo gros brtan pas khong gi gsung 'bum la dkar chag bsdus pa zhig mdzad 'dug /de'i rjes zha lu ri phug sprul skus mdzad pa'i tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa'i nang du/ pod ka nas tsa bar bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don gnyis dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong brgyad brgya lnga bcu bzhugs/da lta pe cing mi rigs pho brang du pod bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don brgyad dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong dgu brgya lnga bcu rtsa brgyad bzhugs zhes gsal yang nga tsho'i gong gi dkar chag gnyis po da sngon mjal rgyu ma rnyed/ de yang zha lu ri phug sprul skus dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa ljags rtsom gnang ste/ sngar rtag brtan gyi shing par dus zing dbang —2—

gis nyams chag shor ba rnams/ kha gso mdzad tshul thos kyang zhib phra'i lo rgyus kha gsal mjal rgyu ma byung / da lta dgen 'jam dbyangs rnams rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa'i par rnying pod bcu bdun 'di/ zha lu ri phug sprul skus nyams gso mdzad pa de yin nam snyams ste/ da lta rtag brtan gyi par rnying bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa pod bco lnga dang / pod grangs dang chos tshan mang nyung tshig mtshams sogs cung mi 'dra ba yod pa'i phyir/da lam nga tshos khong gi gsung 'bum glog klad nang du bcug skabs kyi thog ma'i ma dpe ni/ nye char bla ma yon tan bzang pos 'dzam thang du shing par la brkos pa'i glegs bam nyer bzhi can de la byas te zhu dag thengs gsum byas/ de rjes sngar jo nang rtag brtan du bzhugs pa rtsom pa po tā ra nā tha rang nyid kyi phyag dpe skabs 'gar phyag mchan yod pa/ da lta 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang nang bzhugs bris ma pod chung bcu la chos tshan43la bsdur gzhi dang / jo nang rtag brtan gyi par rnying pod bco lnga bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa dang / a ri ba dgen 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa par rnying pod bcu bdun yod pa gnyis phyogs bsdoms kyis/ par rnying pod nyi shu tsam la chos tshan 314byung ba la sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur thengs dang po zhus/—3— —

de nas rtag brtan gyi par pod nyi shu la bsdur gzhi dang / 'dzam thang gi par mas sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur theng gnyis pa zhus pa yin/ 'on kyang par ma snga phyi gnyis dang bris ma gcig bcas dpe gsum po rtsa ba'i cha nas gcig mtshungs su bzhugs pa las khyad par chen po mi 'dug /cho ga'i skor la mi 'dra ba cung zad yod pa ni ma rman dkyus su shor ba yin 'dug pa rnams kyang / gug rtags nang du bcug te gsal po byas yod/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras sbungs bris ma gnyis su dpe ma bzhugs pa/ 'dzam thang par ma'i nang bzhugs gsung thor bu'i skor wa rtags can dang / zha rtags can gnyis dang / za rtags can dbu ma theg mchog gi zin bris rab byed drug pa yan chad/ tā ra nā tha'i zhal gsung slob ma ye shes rgya mtshos zin bris su bkod pa dang / rab byed bdun pa brgyad pa gnyis dza 'go'i dge bshes mchog grub rgya mtshos gsar du bsnan pa/ 'a rtags can nyang yul gyi lo rgyus tā ra nā thas zhabs btags mdzad par grags pa bcas chos tshan121la 'dzam thang gi par ma'i dpe gcig pu las/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras sbungs bris ma gnyis kyi bsdur gzhi ma rnyed/ rtag brtan par rnying gcig pu las gzhan gnyis la med paṃ chos tshan4/ yang rtag brtan dang 'dzam thang par ma gnyis char med pa/ 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang du bzhugs pa'i gral nas chos tshan bco brgyad la ldeb193gsar rnyed byung —4—

ba bcas la/ zhu dag byas te kha skong gi tshul du bzhag yod pa bcas khyon bsdoms deb bzhi bcu zhe lnga la chos tshan900yod/ da lta nga tsho'i ma dpe g.yar rgyu ma rnyed pa sngon rtsom pa po'i phyag dpe'i gral nas yin pa/ 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang / dpe rtags phyi298nang bzhugs gtam du bya ba nor bu'i 'byung gnas ldeb6/ yang phyi508nang bzhugs 'khor lo gsum gyi rnam bzhag chos dbyings rgya mtsho'i rgyan rnam par bkod pa ldeb92/ ste lag bris kyi chos tshan gnyis po ma 'ongs par dpe g.yar thabs bya dgos/da lta nga tshos dpe bsdur dang zhu dag gi skabs su ma dpe rtsa 'dzin byas te/ dpe gsum mi 'dra ba'i tshe rtag brtan la〈〈rta〉〉rtags 'di dang /'dzam thang la rtags〈〈rja 〉〉'di/ dag cha nor bcos la gug rtag 'di( 1dang / mchan rnams gug rtag〈 〉'di'i nang du blug yod/gsal bshad zhu rgyu zhig la deb bzhi pa'i nang du/ kun mkhyen dol po pa'i gsung chos tshan bzhi/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang kun khyab kyi gsung lho sgo'i cho ga zhes pa'i chos tshan gcig bcas 'dzam thang par mar bzhag yo/da pa dang / yang sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen gyi gsung dus 'khor phyag rgya'i skor chos tshan gcig rtag brtan par rnying du yod pa rnams rang 'jag bzhag yod pa dang / khong gi rang rnam gtso bor gyur pa'i lo rgyus zhal gdams rnams su/gtsang gi yul skad yin nam snyam pa'i tha snyad go dka' ba mang po zhig —5—

bed spyad gnang ba dag kyang rang sor bzhag yod/da lam bka' 'bum 'di rtsis 'khor nang du blugs pa'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas zhus shing / par skrun tshar lnga brgya'i 'gro song bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas bgyis/ tshar brgyad brgya'i 'gro song stsi krin sogs kyi rgya'i sbyin bdag rnams kyis gnang zhing / tshar nyis brgya'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas bgyis pa bcas kyi mthun rkyen las/ da lam dngos su par du bskrun thub pa byung ste rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/las gzhi 'dir bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang nas ma dpe pod bco lnga g.yar gnang byung ba dang / 'dzam thang bla ma mun sel mchog nas kyang ma dpe btsal rogs dang / go rim sgrig rgyu/ zhu dag bcas la rogs ram gang mang gnang ba dang / khams sprul bsod nams don grub mchog nas nyang yul chos 'byung zhu dag gi rogs ram gnang ba dang / bla ma dpal ldan rgya mtshos zhu dag gi las ka spyi'i thugs 'gan che bzhes gnang ba bcas la thugs rje che zhu rgyu ba'o/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/—6—

khong ni slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / paṇ+ḍi ta gha ya dha ra/gnyos lo tsā ba/ kha rag sgom chung sogs skyes chen mang pos byin gyis brlab/rdes ༵ dā / sgi ces ༵'i' rdo sdu/ ༵spra snro sna~X ༵ dho dho nye 'a dho~X/ rdi lo sna rdo // rdo ༵ sta ༵/rde rdo ga~X rnyi 'i sna~Xrde ngh+ru~Xrdo/ rnyi/ḍā sdu tshi ༵ snro~X dī rjo sras rnam rgyal phun tshogs dgung lo bzhi bcu/rde zhe dgu pa rje 'di'i yab dang /yum rdo rje bu dga' dgung lo bcu dgu pa gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu ༵༷ po~X ༵bla bye gcod sna dzā zhes /ma~X sna ga~X ༵'i/ ltas dang bcas sku tsongs te dang / da/sna ༵ gcig tsam na ༵ lki ༵ rderde~X rnyi ḍi bla sdu kun sna~X ༵ sbyi sna skyi ba lha nga zhi hūṃ /rteX hūṃ sa man sbyi / ༷ ༷pye sngi /shaṃhūṃ sdi/rte ngh+rurderde/rderderde— 1 —

stobs rgyas dbang po sogs rta pa brgya dang drug cu rtsa lnga tsam gdan 'dren du byung nas/ gtsang phyogs su gdan drangs te sku gong ma'i slob ma rdo ring kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ lha dbang grags pa/ mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang sogs kyis chos lung byang rtser khri ston mdzad/ rdo ring pa chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi drung du/ thog ma'i rten 'brel du sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang dang / gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang / lam 'bras gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang dang gdams pa mang po gsan/de nas dgung lo drug pa nas yi ge sbyor klog phul du phyin pa mkhyen te/dbang dang rjes gnang sogs yig thog nas gnang ba la dka' tshegs med pa byung / — dgung lo brgyad par rje gong ma'i dngos slob mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub yongs 'dzin du bsten nas/ tshad ma rigs gter sbyangs pas gzhung don la go ba rnyed rung blo 'dzin la zla ba lnga tsam 'gor/ gzhen yang mdo rgyud kyi gzhung lugs mang por gsan bsam mdzad pas mkhyen rtogs rgyas/dgung lo brgyad la phebs skabs stag lung kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan gdan drangs te thog mar bka' gdams glegs bam gyi lung zhus te/ de nas bod rab byung bcu pa'i chu rta khrums stod zla ba'i tshes lnga (spyi lo1582)la/ chos lung byang rtse'i mchod khang gi yang thog tu/ dpal stag lung pa chen po rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi —2—

mkhan po dang / 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos slob dpon dang / rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang pos dus go ba/chos rje mchod gnas pas grogs dan bgyis te yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen dang bar ma rab byung sngon du 'gro bas dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes te/ mtshan kun dga' snying po bkra shis rgyal mtshan zhes gsol/ dag pa'i gzigs snang du rgya gar gyi paṇa chen dz+wa la nā thas tā ra nā tha zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/chos rje brag stod pa lha dbang grags pa'i drung nas chos drug dang phyag chen sogs/ zab chos mang po gsan pas nang zab lam gyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang las dus 'khor gtso bor gyur pa'i zab chos mang po gsan/ mkhan po lung rigs rgya mtsho'i mdun dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dang rgyud bshad/ dpal rgyal ba jo nang pa'i lugs kyi sbyor drug gi zab khrid mtha' dag gsan te nyams len mdzad/ bu lugs kyi sbyor drug gi khrid kyang rdzogs par gsan/ gzhan yang jo zhal bla ma mang po'i gdams khrid dang bka' bstan sogs rgya gzhung gi man ngag mang po dang / kun mkhyen dol bo pa'i gsung 'bum sogs lung mang po gsan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/rdo rje 'dzin pa ye shes dbang po sogs las/ sa skya jo nang shangs pa zhwa lu 'brug pa kaX tshang / stag lung sogs kyi chos skor bcas rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang khrid man ngag mtha' dag ma lus par gsan/ gzhan yang rgya gar gyi grub chen gu ru lho phyogs pa sangs rgyas sbas pa'i mgon po/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can sogs bshes gnyen mang po'i zhabs la gshugs te/ zhung tshal pa'i chos —3—

skor dang / yang dgon pa'i bka' 'bum/ dwags po lha rje'i bka' 'bum/ ri chos ma drug gi khrid/ mi tri bcu gsum ma'i dbang / sangs rgyas thod pa'i dbang /o rgyan bsnyen sgrub skor gyi khrid lung yongs rdzogs/ mar pa nas brgyud rngog pa'i bka' babs dgyes rdor yab yum/ gur rigs bsdus/ gdan bzhi yab yum/ ma hā mā ya ste drug 'e ti nas brgyud pa 'jam dpal gsang ldan bcas rngog dkyil bdun/rngog ṭīka rin chen rgyan 'dra'i mdzub khrid/brtag gnyis sa rngog gnyis ka'i bshad srol/ stag lung thang pa'i bka' 'bum/sgrub thabs brgye rtsa'i rjes gnang /ni gu chos drug 'jam dkar gyi rjes gnang /'grel wo dri med 'od dang /rdo rje snying 'grel dang / dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgya gzhung / dgyes rdor skor la gtso che'i chos sna sum cu so dgu dang / gdan bzhi'i khrid tshul rgyas pa/ ār+ya de wa'i chos lnga sogs rgya gzhung bcu/ sa ra he'i chos lnga/ nag po'i gzhung drug lha hi smad lnga/hril bu skor gsum/ gshed dmar bi rū pa'i gzhung brgyad/ ku ku ri pa'i chos bdun/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes sogs dgyes rdor gyi gzhung shin tu mang po dang / dpe med 'tsho'i sbyor drug rtsa 'grel/dza lan+ta ri'i do ha/ sems kyi phyag rgya sogs mdo sngags spyi dang / khyad par du gsang sngags rgyud sde'i dbang bskyed rdzogs mtha' yas pa gsan/de nas dgung lo bcu bdun pa rab byung bcu pa'i lcags yos hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bdun (spyi lo1591)la/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mkhan po/ bla ma byams pa lhun grub kyis las kyi slob dpon/dge ba'i bshes gnyen blo bzang pa dang / rje drung kun dga' bsod nams —4—

sogs kyis kha skong gnang ste bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes te/ phyi ltar ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan 'chang ba'i dge slong 'dul ba 'dzin pa/nang ltar gzhan phan snying rje chen pos thugs rgyud yongs su brlan pa'i rgyal sras sems pa chen po/ gsang ba bskyed rdzogs kyi zab gnad la mnga' brnyes pa'i sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa zhig tu gyur/de nas bsam sdings su dpal ldan bla ma dam pa byams pa'i mtshan can gyi drung du rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang yongs rdzogs dang / dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang bcas zhus/ bla ma dpal ldan chos kyi bzang po'i zhal snga nas/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang yongs su rdzogs pa bdag po chen po'i mthar thug pa dang / gsang bdag 'khor lo chen po/dril bu lha lnga/ gzungs grwa lnga/ dril bu lus dkyil sogs dbang mang po gsan/ g.yin yang dge ba'i bzhes gnyen rnams las/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs dang / zhabs lugs/ gzhan rje gshed dgra gdong 'jigs gsum/gshed dmar bram ze dpal 'dzin gyi lugs/ gdan bzhi'i gzhung bdun/sangs rgyas thod pa phyogs kyi rgya gzhung mang po dang / rgyud sde 'og ma ci rigs pa dang / grub pa sde bdun/ snying po skor drug yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor rnams dang / phreng ba skor gsum/ rgyud 'grel grags can phal che ba dang /bslab btus dang / byang sa sogs gzhung mang por thos bsam gnang bas blo gros kyi lus stobs ches cher rgyas te gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i mkhas pa chen por gyur/—5—

de nas bla ma kun dga'i mtshan can dang slob dpon rin po ches bka' ༷rgyad skos /pa'i pa smi sngi dhi / bye//ri / rtsi ༷ ༵ sgi khri rgya / de pa sgyur mo na pa rje ba //rde ā+oṃ sni bye ra zla skabs /spri ༵ du ngo bo sbya dhi la dun ༵ḍi~Xsna pa ༵rna ༵༵ sdig ra / ༵ bsnyegazi ṭā rjida~X ba zhugs spyu /pa/ sdu~X/ shā / ༵ gh+ri ༵ ༵ zhal ༵sna sna/sna dho po ༵ dho bo gcig yin gsung pa dang / bod kyi dge bshe/sa bgres song des kyang nga yang ngo sgob tsho hūm̐ / bye sbi dī/ rmis bar sna chen pas bas po'i/ thre gas po ni dgong s+ho / sam chos kyis sa su myong rtog ba'iX bye ru go /de nas rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta ga rta nan+da dang pra yā mā nan+da gnyis dang mjal 'phrad mdzad de gsung gleng gnang bas/ khong gnyis grub mtha' nang par 'du/ga gnyi thamaX two nī snyug tu mkha pas sa pa ༷ ༵ hūm̐ stsi sna/ rgi /༷ tai spya ༷ rdoX bstan bcos kyang than thun bsgyur/ bha ra ta dang rā ma ya ṇa la sogs pa'i lo rgyus kyang mang du thos/ de skabs rā ma ya ṇa'i srung ma ha nu ma tha'i cho 'phru/la lus —6—

byang chen gyi ri dang mnyam pa'i spre'u dang / bha ra ta'i srung ma rgyal po sgyi ma dngos su mthong bas paṇ+ḍi ta na re/ khyod la 'go bar 'dug mthu dang snyan grags longs spyod chen po yong gsungs na yang / chos la mi dad pa'i lha 'dre bsten pas ci bya snyam nas yal bar dor ba yin zhes gsungs/lo dus chag med jo nang du sbyor drug gi khrid gsungs pas ngo ma 'phrod pa gcig kyang ma byung / rgya gar gyi slob dpon su ni r+pā ṇa shrī dang puṇ+ḍa badz+ra sogs las zab khrid kyi gdams pa mang po gsan/ jo nang du sgrub mchod la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ 'dus pa bdun brgya tsam la dbang bcu gcig pa rdzogs par gnang / dgung grangs nyer drug skor rwa sgreng du phebs te tshogs su chos 'brel tsam dang / rje tsong kha pa'i bzhugs khri'i steng nas lam rim gsungs/dgung lo nyer dgu par jo nang du bzhugs skabs tho rengs shig la rje btsun byams pas zhal gzigs te/ khong rang la thim pa'i gzigs snang byung bas gzhan stong dbu ma'i grub mtha' la nges shes gting nas rnyed/ kun mkhyen dol po pas zhal yang yang gzigs nas lung bstan gnang ba dang /gzim lam du sham+bha lar phyin nas rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku dang mjal te chos gsan pa'i snang ba sogs gzigs snang mang po byung /dgung lo so dgu par chos 'khor lha sar phebs nas dar chen mang po bslangs te jo bo'i mdun thugs smon zab rgyas gnang / de nas kun mkhyen dol po pa'i sku ba ho gsung byon ma dang / thugs rje chen po/ tshe dpag med bcas —7—

byin rlabs can gyi rten gsum po'i mdun du mchod 'bul dang thugs smon rgya chen gnang ste smon lam rgyal ba rgya mtsho yang brtsams/dgung lo zhe gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing yos hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig (spyi lo1615)la/ gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis chos gzhis dang / lha 'bangs sogs rgya cher phul nas mthun rkyen sbyar ba las/dpal rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gnas gzhi'i las grwa btsugs te/ phyi gtsug lag khang dang grwa khang brgya phrag tsam lcags ri dang bcas pa/ nang gi rten sangs rgyas rabs bdun dang / tshe dpag med/ sgrol ma/yum chen mo/ dzam bha la sogs gser zangs las grub pa mang po dang / dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku zhal phyag yongs rdzogs gser zangs las grub pa dang /bde gshegs mchod rten cha brgyad sogs rten gsum dpag tu med pa bzhengs/jo nang du yang lha khang gsar bzhengs dang nang rten byams chen thog tshad gnyis tsam gser zangs las grub pa sogs mang po bzhengs/ gzhan yang lha bzo sogs lag rtsal pa rnams dang po rgya bal sogs nas gdan drangs/ de nas bris pa dang / spar brko shing bzo sogs lag rtsal pa gso skyong gnang bas/las rigs lag rtsal pa rnams kyang g.yin la re mi dgos pa byung ste/ bka' bstan 'gyur ro cog tshar mang po dang / bka' 'bum skor po ti bzhi bcu shing par du brkos pa sogs rten gsum mang po gsar bzhengs gnang /skabs shig ri bo che nas rgya dpe pod bcu tsam zhig 'byor byung ba'i nang / yar klung lo tsā ba'i phyag dpe ngo ma dus 'khor 'grel chen pod gnyis —8—

'dug dus 'khor rgyud kyi dpe de dbus phyogs nas snga mo zhig tu lag son byung ba dang / 'grel pa 'di skabs su rnyed pa la ya mtshan chen po byung ste thengs mang bklags pas zung sbyor la yang blo skyed chen po byung / gzhan yang dbang mdor bstan gyi 'grel pa don dam bsdus pa'i mdzad byang la nā ro pa'i mtshan yod pa dang / kyai rdo rje'i 'grel pa rdo rje'i tshig bsdus kyi mdzad byang du byang chub bzang po'i skad dod bo dhi bha dra zhes yod pa sogs mang po byung /yang skabs shig gtsang pa sde srid kyis sog po'i steng du dmag dpung chas rtsis la srung 'khor dang sku rim gnang ba'i tshe/ khong ni rje tsong kha pa chen por lhag tu dad pa che ba dang / khyad par du chos sde chen po 'bras sbungs la nye sems kyi bag chags shin tu che ba zhig yod pas/ chos sde chen po de nyid dar zhing rgyas pa dang rtsod pa 'jam po'i sgo nas zhi ba'i smon lam btab kyang / nus pa ma thon pa ni phyogs gnyis ka las ngan gyi dbang gis ded pa la g.yol thabs bral zhes gsungs/ de nas dpal 'khor bde chen/ rtse chen chos sde/'jag bsam gnyis/ thar pa gling / rtag brtan chos 'phel sogs dbus gtsang gi chos sde mang por chos dang longs spyod kyi bsnyen bkur rgya chen gnang ste bskyangs/de nas dgung grangs re gcig bzhes pa rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1635) la/ rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gdan sa 'jam dbyangs sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho la gtad de/ chos lung rtse dang jo mo nang du dus khrid phyag len rgyas pa gnang nas/ da res ma gtogs —9—

'dir chos mi 'chad gsungs te bu slob rnams la zhal ta mang po gnang ste/ lo de'i nag pa zla ba'i tshes nyer brgyad la zhi bar gshegs so//slob ma/ sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang ye shes rgya mtsho/mkhan chen rin chen rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub blo gros rnam rgyal rnams dang / sgam po sprul sku/ chos rje ngag dbang pa/ bla ma chu bo chung ba'i sku skye/ mkhan po kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ sprul sku ngag gi dbang po/ tre bo sprul sku/chos rje rin stengs pa/ dus 'khor shar chen pa/ chos rje lha bo pa/ dge slong snying po mtha' yas/ byams pa yon tan mgon po/ ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ mi pham dkon mchog legs pa/ kun dga' 'phrin las dbang mo/gtsang gi rgyal sras kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sogs mang po byung /gzhan yang bstan pa'i sbyin bdag gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal/ byang bdag bkra shis stobs rgyal/ yar 'brog bstan 'dzin mi 'gyur dbang gi rgyal po sogs mang ngo/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/—10—

grub wo dzā lan+ta ra'i do ha'i 'grel pa gsang ba'i mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs/ 1grub wo nag po spyod pa'i do ha'i 'grel pa zab don lde mig ces bya ba bzhugs/ 106ka sna pa'i do ha thor bu rnams kyi 'grel pa ngo mtshar 'bar ba rtse ni lngas/ dra/ rnga ku rnga pe ( /ba/rnga 5 / 166gsang ba'i de kho na nyid rab tu gsal ba'i 'grel pa dbo nongs pa rab gsal bsdo/gas/ 220

ma ljadi ces bya ba bzhugs/na mo badz+ra ā tsar+ya maṇ+ḍa la a dhi pa ta ye/ grub chen dzā lan+ta ra'i do he'i 'grel ba gsang ba'i mdzod ces bya ba/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan bla med ye shes chen po'i dngos/ /ma lus chos rnams thams cad mngon sum mdzad/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba kun gyi skyabs gcig po/ /dpal ldan rdo rje slob dpon mchog la 'dud/ /bde chen mtshar sdug lang tsho rgyas pa'i sku ni mtshan dpe'i rgyan gyis spras/ /yan lag drug cu'i glu dbyangs rnga zlum sgras bos srid gsum kun gyis btud/ /sgyu 'phrul rol pa brgya yis zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor ngo mtshar ston mkhas pa/ /zung 'jug zlos gar rtsen pa'i khyab bdag bdag gi snying la 'jug gyur cig/ zab mo'i mthar thug zab dang rgya che ba/ /sems dpa' kun gyis sems par bya ba'i don/ /zung 'jug las kyang zung gi chos ston pa/ /bla med theg pa bla ma'i snying po mchog /grub pa kun gyi gtsug gi bsten gyur pa/ /grub mchog gsung ni lung dang rigs pa yis/ khrub gyur 'di ni mchog tu rton pa'i gnas/ /grub brnyes gzhung 'di bdag gis rab bshad bya/ /nges pa'i don ni tshig gi yul min yang / /yang dag 'doms mdzad rnams kyi gsung pa'i don/ /don mchog rnams la cung zad nges pa rnyed/ /rnyed bzhin phan pa'i sems kyis deng 'dir bris/ /man ngag thob pa ma yin zhing / khyud —1—

sder ring du ma sbyangs pa/ /gzhung gzhan dag gi rgyas bkab nas/ /rang bzor 'chad cing bdag nyid sgrog /man ngag ji bzhin legs rtogs pas/ /mdo rgyud kun la nges ster zhing / /rtog ges ma bslad rigs tshul la/ /legs par zhugs 'di ya mtshan no/ /de la phan pa dang bde ba ma lus pa nges par dam pa'i chos la brten pa yin cing / dam pa'i chos thams cad kyi rab dang phul dang gtso bo dang mchog dang gya nom pa ni/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i lam rnams yin la/lam de'i snying po ni bde stong gnyis su med pa lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes yin te/ de ni gzhung 'dis shin du gsal bar mdzad do/ /de la 'di mdzad pa po ni/grub pa brnyes pa du mas zhabs la btud pa'i grub chen dzā lan+ta ri pa yin no/ /'di 'chad pa la spyi don dang gzhung don gnyis las/dang po ni/ 'di nyid kyi bla ma brgyud pa rnams kyis/ gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa'i gsung las ji ltar 'byung ba'i mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa ni 'di ltar/ dang por rigs la gnas pa'i chos la mos pa skye bar 'gyur zhing /mos pas bla ma bsten par 'gyur la/ de las gdam ngag mnos ste lam sgoms pas/ 'bras bu sku dang ye shes zung du 'jug pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /des na 'di ltar bya ste/ rigs dang mos pa dang / bla ma bsten pa dang / gdam ngag nod pa dang / sgom bya lam dang / sku dang ye shes zung du 'jug pa ste drug la sa/dang po rigs la/ rigs kyi ngo bo dang / rigs tha dad pa dang / rdo rje theg pa'i rigs nges pa dang / ma nges pa dang / mchog dang dman pa rnams so/ /de la dang po ni/ sems kyi rgyun kun gzhi ye shes rnam par shes pa'i —2—

tshogs dang bcas pa rlung sems tsam gyi snang ba'i yid lus dang zung du 'jug pa'o /gnyis pa ni/ ji skad du/ khams rnams dang ni mos pa dang / /sgrub pa tha dad dbye ba dang / /'bras bu tha dad dmigs pa'i phyir/ /rigs yod nyid du nges par brjod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar yin pas/ 'dir theg pa chen po la/ rgyu 'bras kyi theg pa'i rigs gnyis su dbye bar bya'o/ /gsum pa dang bzhi pa ni/ yang dag par blangs pa'i rigs kyi rab tu phye ba yin te/ de la rigs nges pa ni/ khyad par bzhi dang ldan pa ste/ rgyu'i khyad par sngags kyi theg par smon lam btab pa/ ngo bo khyad par dbang skur ba sogs dge bas gsos btab pa'i bde bar gshegs pa'i khams 'phel ba'i cha/ las kyi khyad par lam la 'dun cing rtsol ba/ rnam pa'am 'dzin stangs kyi khyad par sems can thams cad sangs rgyas la ches myur bar 'god pa'i sems bskyed dang 'brel ba yin la/ gzhan rnams ni ma nges pa yin no/ /lnga pa ni khyad par bzhi las/ dang po'i skabs su bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i theg par zhes dang / gsum pa'i skabs/ zung 'jug gi lam la 'dun cing zhes 'don pa spos pas rung ngo / /drug pa la ni/ sngar gyi khyad par bzhi ldan tsam po ste/ mchog ma yin pa rnams dang / khyad par bzhir ma tshang ba gcig ldan la sogs pa'o/ /gnyis pa mos pa la/ mos pa chung ngu dang / 'bring dang / chen po dang /rab dang / mchog rab dang / bla na med pa ste drug las/ dang po 'jig rten pa'i —3—

dge ba dang / theg pa dman pa gnyis la 'dun pa'i las can te/ las dang 'bras bu rnams dang thar pa'i phan yon la yid ches pa las byung ba/ snying stobs dang shes rab dman pa'i grogs dang ldan pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni 'gro ba sgrol bar 'dod pa dang / theg pa mchog la yid ches pa las byung ba/ rang gzhan mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa'i shes rab dang / gzhan don gyi snying stobs 'bring gi grogs can bla na med pa'i byang chub la dad pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ g.yin rnams de nyid dang 'dra ba las/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i theg pa'i yon tan mthong nas/ der smon lam btab pa'i rgyus 'gro ba rnams myur du sgrol ba'i 'dun pas sad pa zhes rgyu'i skabs su sbyar bar bya'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ phal cher de nyid dang 'dra ba las/ dus shin tu myur ba zhes dang / sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung 'phral du 'gog par 'dun las byung ba/dag pa'i gsal snang dang 'brel ba zhes lhag por sbyar ro/ /lnga pa ni/ bde ba chen po'i sdom pa dang 'brel ba bla med byang chub la 'phral du 'dun pa mtshan med kyi shes rab dang bde chen gyi dga' ba'i grogs can no/ / drug pa bla na med pa'i dad pa ni/ rang lam dang tshogs sbyor gyi 'bras bu mngon tu gyur pa'i yid ches sgom byung dang / sangs rgyas mang po las dngos su gdam ngag nod pa'i thos pa'i shes rab kyi rgyu can/ mtshan med spros bral mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis 'gro ba kun stong ba nyid la 'jug pa lam dang bcas pa la mos shing 'dun pa'o/ /—4—

gsum pa yongs su 'dzin pa'i bla ma rnam pa gsum ste rkyen gyi bla ma rdo rje slob dpon/ rgyu'i bla ma lam gyi ye shes/ lhan cig byed pa'i bla ma phyag rgya rnam gsum/ de gsum ga la/ ngo bo/ dbye ba/ bsten tshul gsum gsum du dbye'o/ /dang po'i ngo bo ni/ rdo rje theg pa'i lam la slob ma 'god par mdzad pa'o/ /dbye ba ni/ las dang po'i skabs rnal 'byor can gyi bla ma dang / brtan pa cung zad thob nas 'dod pa'i lha'i rnam pa rang sems gyi snang ba dang / brtan pa thob nas gnas gsum gyi mkha' 'gro ma sprul pa'i sku dang / brtan pa cher thob nas sprul pa'i sku dngos dang longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yin la/ de'i dang po la/ dam tshig bzlas pa spyin pa dang / /'chad byed man ngag ston pa dang / /dbang bskur ba dang las byed pa/ /zhes pa ltar drug go /de dag kyang rgyas par rgyud las 'byung ba ltar skyon spang shing yon tan dang ldan par shes par bya'o/ /bsten tshul ni rgyas par gzhan du go bar bya bas 'dir ma bkod do/ /gnyis pa'i ngo bo ni/ gong ma'i ye shes gsal bar ma sto pa'i mthu can no/ dbye ba ni/ dang po'i bla ma zhes pa bskyed rim shin tu mthar thug pa'i ye shes dang / lhan cig skyes pa'i bla ma zhes pa rdzogs rim dngos gzhi'i zhu bde skad cig ma dang po dang / bde chen gyi bla ma zhes pa phyag chen las thob pa'i zhu bde mthong lam gyi skad cig ma re re'i snga logs su 'gyung ba de'o/ /nges par 'byin pa'i bla ma zhes pa/ sa 'og ma nas gong mar 'phar ba'i dus kyi 'og sa'i ye shes yan lag bdun ldan no/ /bsten tshul ni/ lam de nyid dang rgyu tshogs kyi rigs mthun rnams goms par byed pa yin no/ /—5—

gsum pa'i ngo bo ni/ zhu bde'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyu'o/ /dbye ba ni/lam dang ye shes dang phyag rgya chen mo'o/ /ye shes la dam tshig gi phyag rgya dang /brtags pa'i rig ma'o/ /phyag chen la/ rnam bcas dang rnam med gnyis so/ /dngos btags ma phye bar de kun la dang por bde ba spyin pa dbang gi dus dang smin byed kyi phyag rgya bskyed rim pa'i skabs dang / zhu bde 'bras bur byed pa rdzogs rim dngos gzhi ma thob bar dang / rang bzhin gyi bde ba 'bras bur byed pa rdzogs rim dngos gzhi thob pa'i so skye'i lam dang / spros bral rnam pa'i phyag rgya 'phags pa'i lam du 'gyung ba rnams so/ /ji ltar bsten pa'i tshul ni/ de skad du/ phyag rgya sgom pa'i don du gsungs te nyin mtshan dus su chags pa zad pa'i don du min pa nyid/ ces pa ltar 'dzag med kyi bde ba'i don du 'dod chags stong pa nyid dang bsre zhing sgom pa yin no/ /bzhi pa gdam ngag la/ dbang bskur ba la gdams pa/ dam tshig la gdams pa/ brtul zhugs la gdams pa/ g.yo med la gdams pa/ zung 'jug la gdams pa/ nye rgyu la gdams pa/ ltos med la gdams pa/ rang nyid la gdams pa/ 'bras bu la gdams pa/ cha rkyen la gdams pa ste bcu las/dang po ni/ dbang bskur ba/ 'khor gsum mi dmigs par slob dpon gyis gdams pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dgag sgrub kyi dam tshig thams cad la/ 'khor gsum rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i shes rab dmigs pa med pa'i tshul gyis 'jug pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi brtul zhugs mtshan bcasadang mtshan med gang la yang dmigs pa med pa'i tshul gyis cher 'dzin mi byed par —6—

gdams pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni sgo gsum gyi bya ba rnams la dmigs gtad zhig pa'i stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab bde chen lha skur 'dres pas spyod pa'o/ /lnga pa ni/bde ba chen po la/ spros bral gyi stong nyid kyi rnam pa can gyi dmigs nas sgom zhing / stong pa la bde bas dmigs pa dang / gnyis ka zung du 'jug pa na'ang mtshan ma med par sgom par bya'o/ /drug pa ni/ rang dang / phyag rgya dang / bde ba dang / dbang bskur ba bzhi ka'ang mnyam pa nyid du spyod pa'o/ /bdun pa ni/ sgo gsum gyi longs spyod thams cad la/ re dogs kyi rtsis gang ba med pa dang / rang bzhin med pa dang / ma chags bzhin du cho ga'i sbyor ba dang bcas pa dmigs pa med par spyod pa'o/ /brgyad pa ni/ rnam pa thams cad du bdag rang bzhin mi dmigs pa dang /kun rdzob tu 'gro ba'i don du byang chub la brtson pa dang / gzhi'i bya ba dang lam thams cad kyis rang nyid mtshon par byed pa'o/ /dgu pa ni/ thob bya dang thob byed byang chub mi dmigs bzhin du thob par 'dod pa'i tshul sgom pa ste 'bras bu rang bzhin med bzhin du rang bzhin yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa la mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyi 'dun par byed pa yin no/ /bcu pa ni/ mngon par shes pa sogs gzhan don sgrub pa'i cha rkyen rnams dang bdud dang nyon mongs pa la sogs pa'i bar chad thams cad la rang bzhin med par shes bzhin du rang gzhan gyi don spyod pa yin no/ /lnga pa sgom bya lam la/ las kyi gzhi dang / rkyang pa sgom pa dang / bsdus sgom dang / bsdus sgom rab du gyur pa rnams so/ /dang po ni/ lam gang dang gang la ji srid sems —7—

brtan par ma gyur gyi bar nan tan du sgom pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ bskyed rim dang / rdzogs rim gyi rim pa so sor yang sngar gang goms pa de nyid brtan pa'i phyir sgom pa yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ rim pa gnyis dang / rdzogs rim gyi'ang rtsa rlud thig le'i sems gyi rnal 'byor rnams yan lag bdun ldan gyi rnam pa can du phan tshun rgyas gdab cing phyogs gcig tu sgom pa rtsol bas 'jug pa'i bar du yin no/ /bzhi pa ni/ rtsol med du 'jug cing rnam rtog shin tu nub pas rgyas gdab med par rdzogs rim yan lag bdun ldan kho nar snang ba yin no/ /'dir lam gyi ngo bo de nyid bcu bzhi dang / rdo rje gsum dang / yan lag drug dang kha sbyor bdun dang / ched du bya ba bzhi la sogs pa'o/ /drug pa la sku dang ye shes gnyis las/ sku la gzhi dus dang / bskyed rim pa'i skabs dang / rdzogs rim dngos ma thob pa dang / thob pa dang / 'phags pa'i lam dang / mthar thug gi skabs rnams so/ /de dag re re la yang / sku bzhi dang / rdo rje bzhi dang / sku bcu drug rnams su dbye bar bya ste/ gzhi la ji ltar gnas pa/ lam snga ma snga mas smin cing phyi ma phyi ma sgom pas je bzang du song ste 'bras bu mngon du gyur pa yin no/ /ye shes ni de kho na nyid bdun te/ zab pa dang / rgya che ba dang / khyab pa dang / rtag pa dang / bde ba dang / ye shes kyi sku dang / zung 'jug ste bdun po de dag la yan lag bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis dang / de kun la lam gyi rim pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang bla ma'i zhal snga nas / 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i dbang / /blo ldan bskyed dang rdzogs 'byung bar/ /sangs rgyas 'di bzhin de nyid —8—

bdun/ /'bad de sgom par bya'o kye/ /zhes bka' stsal te/ sku dang ye shes kyi rnam par gzhag pa zhib par gzhan du gtan la dbab par bya'o/ /gzhung bzang rmad byung bdud rtsa'i rgya mtsho cher/ /bla ma dam pa'i man ngag lhun po dang / /rnam dpyod nor rgyas bsrub thag legs sbyar bas/ /mi shes mun sel bdud rtsi'i 'od 'di byung / /nyi zla'i lam las gya gyu 'gro mkhas pa/ /bcu gnyis 'pho ba'i sbyin skyes dpung gi tshogs/ /sgra gcan khyim du mthar byed dga' ston byas/ /gang 'dir srid gsum g.yul las rgyal 'di mtshar/ /gnyis pa g.yi gi don ni/ g.yi 'di nyid glu'i rgyud so sor don shaṃ rnams khrigs su ma mdzad par spel mar bshad cing / glu'i rgyud re rer yang lam cha tshang ba re ston/ de yang dang pos mdor bstan/ lhag ma gsum gyis rgyas par bshad ces bla ma'i zhal snga nas bzhed cing dang pos lam gyi rkang rnams bstan/ gnyis pas ma tshang ba kha skong / gsum pas man ngag gi gnad gces pa rnams ston/ bzhi pas dogs pa gcod pa yin zhes shar phyogs pas gsung ngo / /'on kyang 'di ltar bshad na legs pa yin te/ de la mdor bstan pa dang rgyas par bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni / tshigs bcad gcig ste/rang bzhin rnam par dag pa nyid/ dag ma dag gi gnas skabs thams cad du tshul sna tshogs su 'char yang 'gyur ba med pa nyid do zhes ston pa ni/ a re ho zhes ngo mtshar ba'i tshig ste/ gang la na ri rgyal lhun po dang / rgya mtsho gling bzhi nyi zla dang bcas pa'i snod bcud thams cad rang bzhin gyi dag pa la'o/ ji ltar na/ya mtshan dpal te/ blo gros dman pa dag gi blor mi chud cing / 'gal pa ltar 9—

snang yang mi 'gal pa dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tshul gyis ya mtshan cing /rang gzhan gyi don sgrub pa'i dpal ni gzhi'i dus su/ 'khor ba'i chos thams cad dang / lam dus su dag lam dag gi snang ba thams cad dang / 'bras bu'i dus rten brten pa'i dkyil 'khor gzhan dang gzhan du bsgyur yang / ngo bo nyon sgrib dag cing / shes sgrib rnam par dag la/ glo bur gyi dri ma med cing gdod ma nas sgrib pa dang bral ba'i ye shes kyi sku sems kyi rang bzhin nam yang 'gyur ba med pa na'o/ /su zhig dus nam gyi tshe zhe na/ chos nyid rtogs pa deng nas dzā lan+ta ra pa nga yis ngo mtshar shin du che bar mthong zhes sbyar ro/ skabs 'dir sems kyi steng gi gnyis snang srabs pa las lam gyi ye shes kyi sku dang / dag pa las 'bras bu'i ye shes kyi sku 'grub cing / sems rang bzhin gyi gnyis snang du ma skyes shing / ngo bo la snga phyir 'gyur ba bstan pa med do zhes pa ni grub pa'i mtha' 'o/ /gnyis pa la/ lam gyi spyi'i 'gros dang de dag gi mtha' zhib mor dpyad pa lam sgrub par gdams pa gsum las/ dang po la/ bskyed rim bshad pa dang / rdzogs rim bshad pa/ dang po ni/ tshigs bcad gcig ste/ thig le'i rnal 'byor dang / phra mo'i rnal 'byor ye shes la dbang ba'i skabs kyi gsal snang rab 'byams mched pa yang / rnam rtog gi rab tu btags pa'i dkyil 'khor te/ de'i ngo bo ni bud med de/ phyag rgya'i sbyor ba las/ hūX yig sogs kyi thig le nor bur bkag pas/ rnam rtog zhi bar byed pas/ gnyid dang mtshungs pa'i bde bas myos pa sad pa'i tshe/ bde ba'i sems de/ dbang po'i gzhu dang —10—

'dra ba'i lha skur shar bas/ snang ba thams cad gang ba/ sems lha'i gzugs su shar ba de yang / dngos po med par rtogs pa'i shes rab dang ro cig tu sgoms pa'i gsal snang ngo / /'di dngos rtog med yin na'ang / nye ba'i rgyu rtog pa yin pas rab btags zhes gsung /gnyis pa la/ ye shes kyi sku rgyu dang bcas pa dang bde chen rgyu dang bcas pa gnyis las/ dang po la/ bskyed rim rkyang pas 'grub pa bkag ye shes kyi sku'i ngo bo dang nyer len bstan/ sku sgrub byed kyi thabs gtum mo dang / rtsa rlung thig le'i nges don no/ /dang po la/ zla ba dang / yi ge sa bon dang mtshon cha ste phyag mtshan rnams las bskyed cing byung ba'i kha dog dang dbyibs su rnam par brtags pa'i lha'i sku de yis ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes sgrubs kyang / bskyed rim rkyang pa des bskal pa mtha' yas par 'bad kyang des thob pa ma yin no/ /rnam rtog gi bcos ma'i rang bzhin dkyil 'khor de ni chos can bskal par sgoms kyang ye shes kyi sku mi thob ste/ rnam par rtog pas nyams pa ste mi rtog pa'i ye shes la sgrib pa'i phyir na/ 'bras bu yang gzhan la/ rgyu yang gzhan du rtsol ba'i phyir/ 'bras sa lu pa 'dod pas/ ko ṭa pa'i snye ma srung ba'i ngal ba bzhin no/ /gnyis pa ni rgyu dang ngo bo gnyis las/ nyer len gyi rgyu ni/ rlung sems tsam gyi rang lus te/ lus kyang sems kyi snang ba yin pa'i phyir/ ngo bo gcig pas na/ ye shes kyi sku'i sgrub gzhi sems yin pa'i cha kho na nas nan gyi 'jog pa tshegs che zhing don chung bas lus kyi cha nas 'jog pa legs so/ /de lta bu'i —11—

rang lus de ni lha nyid de/ de yang de ha bha ba zhes pa'i sgra las drangs na lus las byung ba dang lus 'byung ba gnyis ka la 'jug pas/ rags pa'i lus la gnas pa/ khams phra ba thim pa la sogs pa'i rkyen gyi mngon par gsal bar 'byung ba dang / lus sems gyi 'brel ba'i bag chags kyi snang ba de lus gsar pa len pa'i nyer len du 'gyur ba'i don no/ /yang ga gdu na/ bzhin lag kha dog rnam pa ni/ /skyes pa tsam gyi rnam par gnas/ /zhes pa ltar/ rlud sems kyi lus zhal phyag sogs lha sku'i rigs su rang bzhin gyi gnas pa'i don yang yin zhes gsung / de'i rnam pa ji ltar 'char ba'i tshul ni/ yul dus thams cad du sna tshogs pa'i dngos po thams cad kyi rnam par 'char zhing / rgyun chad pa med pas rtag pa yin la rgyun gyi rtag pa'i phyir/ rdul phra rab las grub pa ma yin la/ yid rnam rtog gis bsgoms pa las yongs su 'das pa/ de lta bu'i rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid 'di ni kun rdzob kyi dngos po kun rab du bral yang / dngos po las gzhan pa ma yin te/ kun rdzob ni rang bzhin med pa'i stong pa/ji skad du/ gang la stong pa nyid rung ba/ /de la thams cad rung ba yin/ /zhes pa ltar/ gzhi dang 'bras bu'i chos sna tshogs par 'char ba'o/ /de nyid dus nam zhig gi tshe mngon du 'gyur zhe na nam zhig kun tu gsal ba ste mngon par byang chub pa'i dus su mngon du byed cing / cha shas ni sa dang po'i rjes thob dang / rlung dhu tir thim pa'i nus pa mthar phyin pa'i skabs zhig tu so so skye bos kyang rjes su mthun pa mngon du byed de/ de yang kun tu gsal ba zhes pa ni/ bde stong gi shes pas snang ba kun sgyu ma ltar gsal bar rtogs pa'i don yin no/ /—12—

gsum pa ni/ stong pa nyid ni gtum mo ste/ de yang / tsaṇ+ḍasnyi zhes pa'i sgra las drangs na/ tsaṇ+ḍi khro ba la'o zhes pa'i byings dang / a li ka phyugs la 'jug pas/ phyugs dang 'dra ba'i rnam rtog la khro zhing mthar byed pa ste/ gang mnyam par bzhag pas kun rtog drung nas 'byin pa nges don gyi gtum mo ni mtha' bral stong pa nyid yin la/ de yang lte bar gnad du bsnun pa'i khyad par las de rtogs pa'i thabs su 'gyur ba'i phyir/ stong nyid de lte ba'i me yin zhes bya la/stong nyid de yang rnam bcas gtso che ba yin zhing / bde stong gis 'khor ba dang /rnam bcas des mya ngan las 'das pa zab ste 'gog cing / gtum mo de nyid yang dag pa'i mtha' dang de bzhin nyid ces bya'o/ /'dir 'phags yul ba kha cig lte ba'i me stong nyid kyi rang bzhin zhes 'chad pa nus pa chung zhing / srid 'das kyi mtha' gnyis g.yas g.yon gyi lam la 'chad pa ma 'brel zhes gu ru lho phyogs pas gsung / rtsa sogs kyi nges don ni rkang pa drug ste/ rtsa ni shing lta bu sbubs can dang / khams ni bcud de khu khrag la sogs pa dang / rlud ni shor rlud lta bu ste yang ba'i khams su lta ba de dag ni/ rmongs pa ba lang bzhin te/ 'khrul la/rje bo dam pa bla ma'i drin gyis ye shes 'bar ba nga ni 'di skad smra ste/ de la rtsa ni nā ḍa zhes pa'i sgra las drangs na rgyun ma chad pa la 'jug pas/ sems snga ma dang phyi mar rang bzhin 'gyur ba mi brtan pa ste de nyid rtsa thams cad kun 'dar du dag pa'i lag rjes yin la/ de'i phyir nges pa'i don gyi rtsa'i de nyid du bstan rdor/ /thi ༵ dho/ rtsa ḍā pa nyi rdo~X /kā ༵ ༵ sa ༵༵ dhi~X sna ༵sngi sa/ rtsad ḍi —13—

khams dang rlud 'gyung lus su snang ba'i gnyis snang gi bag chags zad nas yeshes nyid dkyil ge bor du snang ba ni/ de rnams gnas gyur pa'i don yin no/ /de lha na g.yo ba med pa ni rgyun ma chad pa ste nges don gyi rtsa dang / snga phyir 'gyur ba med pa de'i dbus ste rang bzhin de'i ngang nas dpe med pa'i bde ba ste/lhan cig skyes pa'i bde bar gnas pa ni/ khams thams cad 'od gsal du zhugs pa las mngon du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ nges pa'i don gyi khams kyi de kho na nyid dang / bskyod pa med pa ste rang bzhin mi 'gyur ba las phyogs rnams kun tu 'gro ba ste yul drug po kun la sems g.yo ba'i cha ni rlud dang / de yongs su dag pa nges don du rlung gi de nyid yin cing / chos kyi sku stong pa nyid las bskyod pa med par ye shes kyi snang ba phyogs dus kun tu 'gro ba rlung dag pa'i lag rjes yin te 'bras bu la sbyar ro/ /don dam pa'i sems ni kha phyir lta'i rnam shes rnams dang / gnyis snang la/ sgro 'dogs pa'i sems byung rnams dang nyon yid rnams ma yin la/ kun gzhi yang bag chags kyi brten gnas gyur pa/ dri ma'i cha dag pas nam mkha' bzhin gnas pa gnyis su snang bas bsam du med pa/ dngos po kun tu rang bzhin med pa'i tshul gyis ye shes kyi snang ba 'jug pa ste don dam pa'i 'od gsal lo/ /de ltar na rtsa rlung thig le thim pa'i sems 'od gsal ni ye shes kyi sku'i rgyu'o/ /gnyis pa bde ba chen po rgyu bcas bshad pa la/ zhu bde dngos su 'dzin tshul de nyid don dam pa'i lhan skyes ma yin par ston pa/ lhan skyes sgrub pa'i rkyen/ lhan skyes dngos bshad pa bzhi las/ dang po ni/ tshangs pa'i me ste/—14—

gsang ba'i gtum mo/ rdul gyi khams dbu mar 'bar bas/ spyi bo'i ri bong 'dzin pa ste/ byang chub kyi sems zhu ba dbu ma'i nang nas babs pa las/ lte ba man chad du phyin pa'i tsha/ lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba bla na med pa rnam par rgyas pa ste/ dbang bzhi'i bde ba yas babs kyi rim pa rdzogs par 'gyur la/gtum mo'i me de nyid kyi stobs kyis zhu ba'i khu ba ma lus pa spyi bor 'phangs nas thams cad la khyab par gyur ba'i mas brtan lhan skyes gyi bde ba ni zhu bde gzhan gong na med pas bla na med pa ste de la tshad bzung ba dang ngag gi brjod du yod pa ma yin no/ phyi nang gi srog rtsol gang las zhu bde 'dren kyang tshul 'di tshang ba yin no/ /gnyis pa ni dgod pa dang gnyis sprod 'khrig pa la sogs pa sdug bsngal mi bzad pa ni dus mtha' med pa'i bar du byung ba'i rgyur gyur pa yin te/ bag chags de'i stobs kyis yang srid len par byed do/ /de'i phyir stong pa dang sbyor ba med pa'i zhu bde de la thabs shes gnyis med kyi rnal 'byor don dam pa'i bde ba zhes 'khrul ba ni blo gros ngan pa yin te/ de don dam lhan skyes bde chen de yi nyer len gyi rgyu yin pa la bsam na ni mi 'thad la/ de nyid dngos ni/ de bas kyang ma yin no/ glo bur ba g.yo ba'i sems las skyes pa'i rang bzhin bde ba chen po g.yo med ga la yod de med la/ glo bur las rang bzhin 'byung ba dang / g.yo ba las g.yo med 'byung na ni nyer len gyi rgyu'i rnam gzhag rnam par 'khrul zhing / mo gsham las skyes pa'i skyes bu mkhas pa de lta bu ni a ho rmad du byung ngo zhes mi rigs par brjod pa'o/ /nam mkha'i me tog ya mtshan can ltar —15—

rang bzhin dang bcos ma'i gzhi mthun pa 'di lta bu su yis mthong ste ma mthong la/ de bzhin du g.yo ba'i bde ba yang yin la/ rang bzhin bde chen yang yin pa/ myong ba dang myong bar 'gyur ba'i skyes bu de gang glo bur dang rang bzhin/g.yo ba dang mi g.yo ba gzhi mthun pa med de/ 'gal ba ma 'khru/la ba mi srid pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar yang / bram ze chen pos/ de ltar yin te de ni ma yin no/ /grogs po phag dang glang po ltos/ /zhes gsungs so/ de'i phyir gang dag bde chen stong par 'char ba med par/ dngos dang yid kyis bsgoms pa'i bud med de phyag rgya'i sbyor ba las/ rang bzhin lhan skyes bde chen sgrub par 'dod pa ni rmongs te/ ri dwags shin du skom pa chu 'dod pas smig rgyu'i rjes su 'gro ba dang mtshungs so/ /'o na bde chen gyi don du/ las kyi phyag rgya bsten pa ni ci snyam na/gsum pa ni/ ji ltar mtshan mo'i dus su nor bu 'tshol ba na/ mar me bzung bas btsal na myur du rnyed cing / rnyed pa'i phyi nas sgron me rab tu 'dor ba bzhin du/ pad+ma can la sogs pa'i rtsa rin po che'i nang du chud cing gnas pa las thob pa'i zhu bder snang ba lhan cig skyes pa'i rin po che rnyed nas/ phyi rol gyi phyag rgya'i bya ba dang / yid kyi bsgom pa sogs rtsol ba can gyi ngal bas gnas par mi bya ste/ zhu bde tsam gtso bor mi bya'o/ /bzhi pa la/ zhu bde'i dus dang/ dbye ba dang / ngo bo gsum las/ dang po ni/ dus gang gi tshe ngos bzung zhe na/ gang gi chu skyes te phyag rgya'i rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma zhes bya ba'i rtsa dang / bung ba ste thabs kyi rin po che'i bar na —16—

rab tu gnas ste/ nor bu'i nang du son pa lhan cig skyes pa 'di ni/ rang bzhin gyi bde chen skyed pa'i don du mkhas pa dag gi blang ba ste bsgom par byos shig /gnyis pa ni/ rdzogs rim gyi lhan skyes de yang / dga' ba la sogs pa rnam pa bzhi'i bdag nyid yin te/ dges pa'i rdo rje las/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i phyogs la ni/ /'di ltar lhan cig skyes rnam bzhi/ /zhes rdzogs rim mthon por song ba'i skabs shig gis/ dga' ba bzhi ka lhan skyes yin par gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'o na/ dang po dga' ba 'gro ba'i gzugs/ /de bzhin mchog dga' 'gro ba nyid/ /dga' bral dga' bar 'gro ba nyid/ /gsum pa lhan cig skyes pa med/ /ces/ dga' ba dang po gsum dang / lhan skyes gzhi mthun pa med par gsungs pa ma yin nam zhe na/ bshad par bya ste/ de nyid las/ yang na de nyid thams cad bdag /yang na kun gyi rnam par spangs/ /zhes skyed rim pa dang /rlung dbu mar zhugs gnas thim gsum byang ma chub kyi bar du zhu bde'i dga' ba dang po gsum la/ lhan skyes kyi don ma tshang zhing / de phan chad kyi rdzogs rim gyi mas bstan dga' bzhi thams cad lhan skyes kyi dga' ba kho na yin la/ lhan skyes yin min gyi don yang / khams phra rags thams cad thim pa'i thams cad stong pa'i rang bzhin yin pa dang / bde ba myong bas 'bad rtsol drag po med par spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i stong pa'i rnam pa ngang gi 'char ba yin min gyi khyad par ro/ /phyag chen thig ler/ dga' ba bzhi dang snang ba bzhi gcig par gsung na/ dga' bzhi la lhan skyes yin min gyi dbye ba ltar/ thams cad stong pa yang snang ba gsum yin min gnyis su dbye mi dbye'i khyad par dang 'thad pa zhib —17—

mor dpyod ldan r+ṣa po 'gas/ sngar rnam par dpyad cing / da dung dpyad par bya dgos mod kyi yi ge mangs par 'gyur pa'i phyir 'dir mi bri'o/ /gsum pa ni rdzogs rim gyi lhan skyes kyi ngo bo rlung dang khams g.yo ba med pa'i bde ba yin te/ de 'dra'i bde ba de yin phyin chad/ zhugs gnas thim gsum gyis rlud gi g.yo ba 'gags shing / thig le 'dzag med kyi bde ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rdzogs rim gyi lhan skyes ji ltar bshad pa de rnams la/ zhu bde dang / rang bzhin gyi dbye ba zhib mor 'chad pa ni 'og nas 'gyung ngo / /'dir smras pa/ bde chen bde ba'i dga' ston rol ba yi/ /phyag chen phyag rgya'i mchog gyur legs bsten na/ /ye shes ye nas dag pa'i lha sku mchog /gnyis chos gnyis med ngang du ro mnyam gyur/ /glu yi rgyud dang po rnam par phye zin to/ / de ltar lam gyi spyi'i 'gros rnams legs par bstan nas/ gnyis pa de dag gi mtha' zhib mor dpyad pa la/ glu'i rgyud gnyis pa dang / gsum pa dang /bzhi pa'i stod phal che ba rnams yod pa las/ glu'i rgyud gnyis pa la don tshan/bod kyi bshad srol lhar/ sa gcod ji bzhin sgrig dka' la / rgya gar ba'i bshad rgyun las byung ba'i bsdus don ji lta bar bshad na bde bas 'di ltar/bde ba chen po'i rgyu tshogs dang / bde chen sgrub tshul dang / las rgya'i dgos pa dang / des ye shes kyi sku 'grub tshul dang / lhan skyes kyi ngo bo dang / lhan skyes dman pa'i skyon dang / bde stong sgom tshul dang / des sems kyi dri ma sbyong tshul dang / phyi'i phyag rgya spangs nas phyag chen gyis 'grub tshul dang / bde stong spyod pa gsum gyi dogs spyod dang / rlud thim pa'i sbyor ba dang / bde stong la log rtog —18—

'gag pa dang / lhan skyes 'char ba'i thabs kyi gtso bo la gdams pa dang / lta ba dang bzhi pa'i ye shes la 'khrul pa dgag pa dang / stong pa rtogs tshul dang /'od gsal 'char tshul dang / stong pa sgom tshul dang / bde ba'i skyon mtha' gnyis dang / bde chen gyi ngo bo dang / khams thim tshul dang / ye shes kyi sku sgom tshul dang / de rtogs pa'i phan yon spyod lam dang bcas pa dang / mngon par byang chub pa'i lus gnad dang /gnas dang / grogs dang / dus dang / lhan skyes phyi nas tshol ba spang bar gdams pa dang / de sgra rtog gi yul las 'das pa dang / de nyid 'grub pa'i ltas dang / don dam la gzhol ba'i rnal 'byor pas sems lus 'dod yon gsum la gnad du bsnun par gdams pa ste don tshan sum bcu las/ dang po la/ snang ba kun la bde bas rgyas 'debs pa/ des rnam rtog gcod tshul/ bde ba sgom tshul/ de thob byed rkyen gyi gtso bo/ de 'grub byed kyi spyod pa la 'khrul pa bkag pa ste lnga las/ dang po ni/ a i zhes bde ba dang /a ri zhes stong pa la so sor ngo mtshar ba'i tshig ste/ ci ltar zhe na/ sa 'ogs steng / sa bla gsum mam/ 'dod pa dang / gzugs dang / gzugs med gsum mam/ lus ngag yid kyi khams gsum dang / sa chu me rlung dkyil 'khor bzhi dang khams gsum gyi 'gro ba ste sdod bcud kyi 'jig rten bdun nam/ rig drug dang / srid pa bar ma'i 'jig rten te/ sems can gyi 'jig rten bdun gyi gos sna tshogs pa dag bde ba chen po lhan cig skyes pa'i 'dod chags chen po ste bde chen gyi tshon gyi kha dog gcig tu kha bsgyur pas na zhes gzugs can gyi rgyun gyi tshul du sbyar zhing / ngag don ni / lhan skyes che chung ci rigs brtan nas/ snang —19—

ba thams cad la bde ba des rgyas btab pas/ slar yul snang des grogs byas nas bde ba cher 'phel zhing / snang ba thams cad bde ba gcig gi rnam rol du 'char ba lta ba dang dar sogs dngos po tha dad pa dag tshos gcig la btsos pas kha dog gcig tu snang ba bzhin no zhes pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ snang ba la bde bas rgyas btab pas/ ma dag pa'i snang ba med pa ste mi snang zhing / rnam rtog gi dran pa nyams shing med par gyur pa dang /bde bar shar ba'i tshe bdag dang gzhan du 'dzin cing rig par mi 'gyur ba ste/de 'dra'i de mngon 'gyur pa 'gag pa yin no/ /zhes yul mtha' ste rgyal khams kun du smras so/ /'dir bzang mo zhes pa ni shes rab la bod pa dang / yul mtha' kun du smras pa yin zhes bskal ldan ldan rnams la'o/ /gsum pa ni/ yid rnam par rtog pas g.yo ba med pas rengs pa dang /mig gnyis ni nam mkha' la g.yo med du lta bas rengs pa ste/ de ltar yang /nam mkha' la ni yid dang rlung dang mig /dus cig tu ni gal te nges sbyar na/ /rin chen rgyal ba'i yon tan nges par skye/ /'di dag mtha' dag de bzhin gshe/gas pas gsungs/ /sna tshogs rnam rtog bral zhing mi sems par/ /gal te bar snang la ni mig gtad na/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten mtha' dag yin nam snyam/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug thams cad 'di las 'thob/ /ces bde chen sgrub par byed pa'i mchog rnam bcas phyag chen sgrub pa'i thabs 'di gnyis gtso bor gsungs so/ khu ba rlung dang rnal 'byor ram ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs kyis mi g.yo ba ste 'dzag med du byed pa dang / rlud rnams dhu tir 'ching ba dang / des gtum —20—

mo 'bar bas khams zhu zhing 'khor lo bzhir brtan par byed pa dang / khyad par byang chub kyi sems gyen du gshegs pa'i mthu dang ldan pa'i phyir zo chun gyi 'khor lo dang mtshungs pa'i 'khor lo bzhi chus khengs pa ste gnas de dang de rnams su thig le lugs ldog tu brtan par byed pa'i bde ba sgom pa dang / lhan skyes kyi bde ba nam shar ba na/ lus sems thams cad dga' bde rgyas par 'gyur zhing gtum mo 'bar bas spyi bo'i thig le zhu ba snying khar phyin pa na'ang dga' bde khyad par can bskyed pas dpyid ka dang mtshungs pa'i dus kyi dang po bde ba shar ba rten ma thag tu/ de la mtshan ma'i spros pa dang bral ba'i rnam par mi rtog pa sgom pa ste drug po 'di dag la 'bad par gyis shig kyai ha ṭi ba zhes grub chen nyid kyi rang la rang nyid kyis bskul ba ste/ rang la bod pa sogs ni zab mo'i don gzhan gyi mtshon par mi nus pas rang las mtshon par gyis shig ces pa'i don yin gsung /bzhi pa ni/ rlung bcu po rnams ni rnam rtog gi ri mo sna tshogs 'dri bar byed cing cung zad kyang gnas pa'i skabs med la/ las dang nyon mongs pa dang sdug bsngal rnam pa gsum gyi tho chor spyod pas 'phyar g.yeng can yin la/ de nyid g.yo med du byas na/ dga' ba'i gzhir gyur pa'i phyir/ bu mo ste/ des rang gi khyim dang 'dra ba de nyid las 'gyung zhing de nyid du thim pa'i dh+wa ti'i nang du zhugs gnas thim gsum gyi bkug la dbang du gyur pa'i 'dad pa gyis shigaci ltar bgyi zhe na/ lte ba dang gsang ba'i phug tu tsaṇ+ḍali mar me spor zhigakyai ha ṭi ba zhes bos nas/ yan lag ro ma dang yan lag rkyang ma'i sgo bsdams —21—

shing 'byud pa ste dbu mar gcig tu dril bas/ dbu mar khu ba 'bab pa'i 'dod pa 'i bde ba sbyad par bya'o/ mtshan mar 'dzin pa thams cad stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi za ba dang / sems kyi rgyud bde ba chen po'i bcud 'thung ba dang / 'jug gnas ldang gsum gyi rlud nyal ba dang / ma chags pa'i tshul gyis 'dod yon la rol ba'i rtsed mo rnams las/ sgra don gyi rjes su 'brang ba'i mtshan 'dzin gyi klog pa dang / tha mal ba'i nga rgyal gyis rlung rgyu ba'i kha don mi bya'o/ 'dir ngag don ni/ zhu bde lhan skyes kyi rgyu'i gtso bo rlung dbu mar thim pas gtum mo 'bar ba yin la/ rang bzhin lhan skyes kyi rgyu'i gtso bo bde stong bsre ba'i thabs la 'bad pa dang / rlud gi bgrod pa phra mo 'gog par byed pa yin la/ sems kyi rang bzhin bde ba chen po'i khams su gnas pa ni rang byung lhan skyes sam rang bzhin lhan skyes zhes bya la zhu bde'i bde stong sbyar ba la sogs pa thabs kyi sems de bde chen dngos su gyur pa ni rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes yin no zhes bya'o/ / cilnga pa ni/ dzā lan+ta ra pa bdag ni rang gi khyim ste gnas cig pu na 'dug cing spyod pa spyad pas dngos grub thob la/ phyugs rnams ltar rnam par rmongs pa'i 'gro ba kha cig ba ra ṇa si dang / dwa ri ka dag tu mi lnga bsten pa sogs kyi rang nyid sdug bsngal bar byed la/ de ltar lus lha yin pa la brnyas shing gdung ba tsam ste sdug bsngal ster bas/ bdag nyid kyi bde ba 'phrog par byed pa 'di lta bu'i lam ngan pa ston pa'i pad+ma'i skye gnas te tshangs pa de ni byol song ltar blun pa yin te/ log pa'i lam bstan pas/ sdig pa'i khur po shin tu lci ba de lta —22—

bu ched kyis 'chang ba'i phyir ro/ 'dir cung zad dpyad na/ lus la gdung ba brtsams pa tsam gyis ci ltar sdig par 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis rang gi sha sbyin pa la sogs pas ni/ thabs des tshogs gnyis rdzogs par yang mi 'gyur ram/ gal te mu stegs can de dag la thabs de med do snyam na de ni med mod kyi/ de la ni ngal zhing dub pa'i mtha' zhes gsungs kyi bsod nams nyams par byed par ma gsungs pas/ 'di ni mi rigs so zhe na/ 'dir sdig pa zhes bya ba ni yang dag pa'i don mthong ba la/ sdig pa dang 'dra bar gegs byed pa la sdig pa zhes brjod pa ste/ 'dis ci ltar gegs byed ce na/lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba rtogs pa ni lus kyi bde ba la rag lus shing ye shes kyi sku yang / lus dang ro gcig du gnas pa'i rlung sems gnyis kyi rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ de la smad cing bde pa'i mi mthun phyogs la 'bad pas/ thog ma med pa nas goms pa'i bag chags tha mal par 'dzin pa dang / sdug bsngal du zhen pa lhag par brtan pa 'gyur zhing / gzhan du 'ga' zhig bde ba'i dbang bskur ba thob pas ni/ phung po sangs rgyas su gyur pa la brnyas pas sdom pa nyams par byed pa'i rtsa ba'i lhung bar yang 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa bde chen sgrub tshul la/ shin du spros med kyi spyod pa'i lha dang gnas bshad/ des phyag chen gyi bde ba sgrub tshul/ las kyi phyag rgyas bde chen sgrub tshul lo/ dang po la/ ha ḍi ba bdag gis spros pa la dga' ba'i rnal 'byor pa rnams la smras pa/ shin du spros med kyi spyod pa 'di la/ lha dang gnas med pa ma yin te/ rang gi lus nyid la ye shes kyi sku rnam pa gnyis gnas pa'i phyir lha yin la/ gnas dang nye gnas la —23—

sogs pa'i yul nyer bzhi yang / spyi bo la sogs pa rang gi lus kyi cha shas dag yin pas na/ zhing kun bgrod par 'dod pas/ yul kun tu 'khyams pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams ngal bar ma gyur tam ste/ don chung la ngal ba che ba kho nar zad do/ 'dir spyi bo la sogs pa'i rtsa nyer bzhi po de rnams nyid/ gnas nyer bzhir 'jog pa ni/ de dag gi rlung dang khams thim pas yul so so'i pho nya mo rnams dang / 'du ba thob cing yul so so'i lha mo dang 'dus pa las kyang rtsa dang / rlung dang / khams de dang de thim pa'i nus pa yod pa'i phyir de ltar gzhag go /gnyis pa ni/ zhu bde lhan skyes kyi bde stong dang rang bzhin lhan skyes mngon du gyur pas ni/ bya ba med pa ste spros pa thams cad dang bral bar mnyam par gzhag pa na/ rnam bcas sam rnam med kyi stong pas bde chen 'dren cing stong pa de'i ring nas bde ba sgom pa las kyang bde ba chen po 'dren cing 'byung ste/ de 'dra ba'i rnam pa mang po dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo sna tshogs su snang ba'i rnam bcas kyi stong nyid dang/ spros pa thams cad rang bzhin med pa'i tshul la zhugs pa tsam gyi rnam med stong nyid de/ bde chen 'dren pa'i phyag rgya chen mo de gnyis ni/ dbugs dbyung rnam pa gnyis kyi don du shes par bya ste/ bde ba chen pos sdug bsngal 'gog cing dbugs 'byin pa'i phyir dbugs dbyung zhes bya la/rnam bcas ni tshul tha dad par snang ba'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i dbugs dbyung dang / rnam med ni thams cad stong nyid du ro gcig pa'i rnam pa can gyi phyir/ ro mnyam rdo rje sems dpa'i dbugs dbyung ba'o/ /gsum pa ni/ phyag rgya bzang mo khyod de skyon spangs shing / yon tan —24—

rdzogs pa gang zhig rnal 'byor ba drod thob pa'am ma yin kyang / rlung dhu tir thim pa dag gi mthong ba ste bltas pa'i rjes chags las kyang / rlung rnams nyams shing dbu mar thim nas/ bde ba chen po lhan cig skyes pa spang bya'i mun pa sel ba'i phyir nyi ma dang 'dra ba 'char ro/ /kyai zhes bod pa'o/ khyad dga'i ye shes khu ba g.yo ba'i dri ma dang bcas shing / bdag tu rmongs pa sogs ma rig pa dang mtshungs par ldan pas/ mun pa lta bu der 'od gsal nyi ma lta bu shar bas ngo mtshar te/ dzā lan+ta ra ba nga gad mo dgod do/ /'dir shes rab ma la bltas pa sogs las/ bde chen 'dren tshul thun mong ma yin pa ni/ rang bzhin lhan skyes gsal bar mtsho ni pa ni zhu bde lhan skyes yin la/ bde ba de bskyed pa la/ byang chub kyi sems dbu mar zhu zhing 'bab dgos/ de yang gtum mo 'bar ba la rag las/ de yang rlung thim pa las 'byung bas pho nya mo mchog ni mthong ba tsam dang / thos pa la sogs pas kyang rlung bsdud pa'i tshul khyad par can gyis bde chen bskyed pa de ni/ bde ba de 'gal rkyen gang gis kyang ldog mi nus shing rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung ba'i phyir/ lam de myur ba la dgongs nas/ rdo rje gur du yang / bud med mchog mthong las bde zhing / /glu thos pas kyang yang dag bde/ /dri zhim mnam las bde ba che/ /skye gnas reg las kyang bde chen/ /ro mchog btung ba rab sbyar ba'i/ /bde ba sus kyang ldog mi nus/ /zhes gsungs so/ de ltar gzugs mdzes pa bltas pa dang / de bzhin du 'dod pa'i gtam dang glu len pa mnyan pa dang / bha ga sogs lus las byung ba'i dri zhim mnam pa dang / ma mchu'i ro myangs pa dang / sgyu rtsal ka ra ṇa'i gar gyi rol pa rnams dang /—25—

skye gnas kyi reg bya la sogs pa mdor na/ bya ba kun la bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin 'di 'dra ba 'thob pa ni ngo mtshar che'o zhes pa'o/ /gsum pa las rgya'i dgos pa ni/ me don du gnyer bas gtsub shing gtsub par byed pa ltar/ bde ba chen po'i don du/ las kyi phyag rgya nye bar bsten pa yin te/ phyag rgya gsum po gang yang rung ba'i shes rab ma la sbyor ba med par lhan cig skyes pa mngon du byed pa med cing / khyad par rang bzhin lhan skyes mtshon pa'i nye rgyu phyag chen dang sbyor ba yin la/ phyag chen gyis zhu bde rgyas par byed ma nus pa dang / phyag rgya chen mo ma thob pa thob par byed pa la/ las dang ye shes kyi phyag rgya nges par dgos shing / bsgoms pa'i yid kyi phyag rgya las/ bde ba chen po 'dren pa la lhag par stobs che ba yin no/ /de'i phyir gtsub shing gtsub pa med na/ me ni gang du 'byung ste/ mi 'byung zhes dper mdzad do/ /de yang he ru ka mngon 'byung las/ dpa' bo gang zhig phyag rgya dman/ /sgrub po mchod pa byed pa ni/ phub ma brdung dang mtshungs pa ste/ /zhes phyag rgya mo med par lam ring la yod na myur bar gsungs shing / 'on kyang / bde mchog gi rtsa rgyud las/ pho nya ral gri'i so 'dra zhing / /zhes gsungs la/ mngon 'byung las/ rnal 'byor med par rnal 'byor chos/ /phyag rgya la ni bgrod 'gyur dang / /ye shes med par ye shes tshul/ /dmyal bar 'gro bar the tshom med/ /ces yul dang brten mtshan nyid ma tshang na nyes dmigs shin tu che'o/ /'dir zhu bde'i lhan skyes thig le dang mi dmigs sgom pa sogs rnal 'byor gyi gtum mo las ci rigs par 'dren nus na yang / des gsal bar ma mtshon pa'i pa bzhin dang snang ba dang dga' ba'i —26—

dbye ba dang / rnam pa dang khyad par rnams ni phyi rol gyi phyag rgyas mtshon par byed cing / zhu bde khyad par can gyi bde stong gi phyag rgya chen mo las/ gtum mo 'bar zhing bde ba drangs pa'i lhan skyes zhu bder gyur ba des rang bzhin lhan skyes gsal bar mtshon par byed cing / yang las kyi phyag rgya'i bde bas/ rlud dbu mar gcig du 'dus pa mi shigs pa'i thig le dang 'dres pas rnam bcas stong gzugs kyi rang bzhin lha mo 'grub la/ de dang mnyam par sbyar bas zhu bde lhan skyes kyis kyang / rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa mtshon pa yin no/ /zhes pa ni grub pa'i mtha' 'o/ / bzhi pa ni/ bcud kyi reg pa'i lcags rnams gser du 'gyur ba ltar bde ba chen po'i grub pa'i dngul chus khams bco brgyad po rnams la reg pas lhan cig skyes pa'i bde chen gyi gser du 'gyur la/ bsgyur ba des dngos po thams cad la rgyas btab pas snang ba thams cad ye shes kyi sku'i gzugs su 'char bar 'gyur te/ ji ltar lcags gser du 'gyur ba yang / lcags kyi dwangs ma mnyen pa dang / kha dog gsal ba'i cha de nyid gser du 'gyur ba yin gyi/lcags nyid du byed pa'i chos snyigs ma'i cha lcags kyi khams ni ma zad par gser du ga la 'gyur te mi 'gyur ba bzhin du/ snyigs ma'i lus rdul phra rab kyi chos gnyis snang gi cha 'di ni ye shes kyi skur mi 'gyur la/ sems bde bar gyur cing khams dkar dmar 'ching lugs khyad par can gyis bcings pas/ snyigs ma 'di zad nas lcags srang gcig la dwangs ma'i cha srang gcig gser du 'gyur pa ltar/ rlud sems tsam gyi lus bzhin lag gi rnam par gnas pa/ de nyid ye —27—

shes kyi lus mtshan dpes spras pa'o/ /zhes bla ma dam pa gsung ngo / /lnga pa ni/'dod chags te mchog dga' ma yin zhing / chags bral khyad dga' 'am dga' bral yang ma yin la/ dbu ma dga' bar yang ni mi dmigs te/ lhan skyes 'di ni gsum ga las 'das pa yin no/ /drug pa la gnyis las/ byang chub kyi sems bde ba chen po'i rten lhung zhing 'dod chags te lhan skyes kyi bde ba nyams pas ni/ gti mug dang zhe sdang gis kun nas dkris pa des dmyal bar 'gro ste/ 'khor bar rnam par 'khyams par 'gyur ro/ de ltar yang dri med 'od las/ 'dod chags nyams pas sdig ste gang phyir shin du sdug bsngal ni zhe sdang skye zhes gsungs so/ /de yang zhu bde'i rkyen gyis sems bde bar shar ba la sred pas/ sems la 'dod chags kyi bag chags bsgos shing bde ba de nyams pa'i tshe/ mi 'dod pa'i yul la spong ba'i sems drag po zhe sdang gi rnam pa can gyis sems rgyud la zhe sdang gi bag chags bsgo bar byed do/ zhe sdang des sems 'khrugs pas shes bya'i gnas la rmongs pa'i gti mug gi rnam pa can gyi sems 'byung ste/ des gti mug gi bag chags bsgo bar byed do/ 'di ni byang chub kyi sems ma bcings pa rnams kyi bgrod pa'i bde ba tsam la yang yod pas/ 'dzag bde phal cher gyi bag chags bsgo tshul yang 'di nyid yin pas/ 'khor ba'i rtsa bar gsungs shing khyad par tshe gcig la dngos grub 'grub pa'i rgyu/ bde wo gyi mi mthun phyogs nyid yin la/ don gyi dbang 'di gzigs nas/ dngos grub kun gyi gter gyur pa/ /byang chub sems ni lhung gyur na/ /rnam shes phung po brgyal 'gyur na/ /ma smad dngos grub ga la —28—

yod/ /ces gsungs so/ /de kho na nyid med pa'i lhan skyes kyi skyon ni/ pra tso da zhes bya ba ni/ de skad du/ zhi ba'i rgyud las/ dbang phyug nus ma mnyams sbyor bas/ /lte bar phyin pa'i bde ba ni/ /chu ni 'thung ba ma yin pa/ /mtshan nyid bral ba rab tu zhi/ /'dis ni drag po rab du bskul/ /zhes de kho na nyid/ med kyang / zhu bde tsam la sems zin pa de kho na nyid du rlom cing khu ba 'ching ba tsam gyis lhan cig skyes pa'i bde chen ma nyams pa'i don du 'gyur la/ 'dis srog chags rnams kyi lus la lha chen po dbang phyug gnas pa de nyid bskul bas grol bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes pra tso da zhes pa bod skad du rab tu bskul ba ste lam 'di mu stegs can gyi lugs yin no/ sangs rgyas pa de kho na nyid med par bde ba sgom pa rnams kyang lugs 'di chos su ston par byed pa ste/ phyugs bdag ste dbang phyug chen pos 'dab chags te mkha' lding gi rgyud du bshad pa'i 'dod chags kyi spong ba'i tshul 'di ni dor bar bya ste/ sems kyi dri ma stug po dpag du med pa sngar yod pa'i chog gid ni 'dis ci zhig bya/ do ha mdzod las/ snying rje bral ba'i stong pa nyid zhugs pa/ /des ni lam mchog rnyed pa ma yin no/ /'on ste snying rje 'ba' zhig sgom na yang / /'khor ba 'dir gnas thar ba thob mi 'gyur/ /gang yang gnyis po sbyor bar nus pa de/ /'khor bar mi gnas mya ngan 'das mi gnas/ /zhes gsungs la/ 'di yi rnying rje yang bde ba lhan cig skyes pa'i cha nas 'jog cing bde ba la sems har sgom du zin pa tsam pos/ bde ba tsam bsgoms pa las gzhan stong pa sgoms par mi 'gyur ro/ gzhan yang bram ze chen pos/ ma lus de nyid gang gis mi shes par/ /ku rgya ru yi skabs su bde —29—

chen sgrub pa ni/ /ji ltar skom pas smig rgyu snyeg pa bzhin/ /skom nas 'chi yang nam mkha'i chu rnyed dam/ /rdo rje pad+ma gnyis kyi bar gnas pa/ /bde ba de brtan nus pa med pas na/ /sa gsum re ba gang gis rdzogs par 'gyur/ /zhes rang bzhin stong pa nyid mi shes par/ bde ba ji tsam che zhing sred pa yang che bas dri ma'i bag chags kyang bsgos tshabs che bar gsungs so/ /bdun pa ni/ yid ces pa/ rnam rtog dang khu khrag gi khams gnyis char la 'jug pas/ skabs 'dir yang / khu ba bcings pa'i bde ba dang / rnam rtog gi g.yo ba mtshan ma dang bral bar bcings pas/ rnam rtog dang bde ba rang bzhin stong pa nyid nam mkha' lta bu yin la/ de la rnam par mi rtog pas nam mkha' ltar spros pa dang bral ba'i rang bzhin du sgom par bya'o/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid du 'char bzhin pa'i rnam rtog ltar snang ba ni/ yid ni g.yo zhing bcings pa dang zhes pa'i don yin ces 'chad gsung / /brgyad pa ni/ bcud len chen po grub pa'i dngul chu dang mtshungs pa'i zhu bde khyad par can la goms pas/ dus thams cad du snang ba gang lhan skyes de nyid rtag du g.yo ba mi byed na/ de'i tshe sems kyi lcags so sor rang gi rig pa'i ye shes kyi gser ni dri ma med par grub pa yin te/ ji ltar dngul chu g.yo ba med pa na lcags gser du 'gyur ba bzhin no/ /'dir grub pa'i mtha' ni/ zhu bde phra mo rgyun mtha'i ye shes kyi bar du yod cing / sangs rgyas kyi sa na med la/zhu bde lhan skyes bar ma chad par 'jug pa ni 'phags pa kho na la yod cing /rang bzhin lhan skyes kyi bde ba des thams cad stong pa dang gcig tu 'dris pa —30—

las nam yang ldang mi srid pa ni/ chos sku mngon du byas pa kho na la yod do zhes pa gsum po 'di'o/ de'i phyir bcud len zhes pa rang bzhin lhan skyes la 'chad pa'ang yod de legs pa yin gsung / 'on kyang dpyad na/ dang po rgyu mtshan/lus sems rten brten pa'i 'brel pa khu rdul rlung gi tshogs pa phra mo de srid du yod pa'i phyir dang / gnyis pa'i rgyu mtshan rtsa khams rlung gsum gyi bgrod pa dngos rnams thams cad dbu mar thim/ phyin chad rang bzhin lhan skyes dang stong ba tsam bsgoms pas kyang zhu bde nges par 'dren pa'i rnam med phyag chen dngos 'grub pa yin la/ de bas na mthong lam skyes phan chad/ mnyam gzhag gi tshe 'od gsal thams cad stong pa'i stobs kyi zhu bde dang lhan cig tu 'jug pa'i rang bzhin lhan skyes gsal bar snang la/ rjes thob kyi tshe des drangs pa'i zhu bde kho na rgya cher 'byung ba yin no/ /zhu bde'i lhan skyes kyi bde stong khu rdul rlung gsum las skyes pa yin kyang / de ji tsam yun ring ba tsam gyis de gsum gyi tshogs pa 'jig tshabs che ba 'di la dgongs nas/ sdig pa dang ni shing srin sems can rnams/ /gang las 'byung ba de de nyams par byed/ /ces gsung pa yin no/ /de bas na bcud len zhu bde dang gser rang byung gi bde ba'i dper sbyar ba legs so zhes kho bo smra'o/ /gsum pa'i rgyu mtshan dri ma spangs pa'i rang bzhin gyi bde chen dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' don gcig la/ byang sems rgyun mtha' pa la yang gnyis snang gi bag chags phra mo yod pa'i phyir de las ldang mi srid pa ma yin no/ /dgu pa ni/ gzugs bzang zhing mdzes pa dang yan lag rnams ma god —31—

pa'i phyir mchog dang / rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'i rtsa sogs phra ba dang /bde ba chen po mchog gi rten kun da rgyas pa'i stobs kyi skra bzang ba dang / thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i lam la sbyangs pas dul ba ste/ dngos grub kyi don du bsten pa'i las kyi phyag rgya gang ci yang rung ba thams cad la/ mtshan nyid de rnams tshang dgos shing / de lta bu'i phyag rgyas g.yas g.yon gyi rgyu ba dhī tir chud pa'i rkyen gyis lhan skyes kyi bde ba spyin par byed la/ shes rab phyag chen thob nas ni/ las kyi phyag rgyas ci zhig bya ste gang gi don du zhu bde dgos pa'i rang bzhin gyi bde ba thogs pa med par 'dren pa'i phyag rgya thob zin pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar yang bram ze chen pos/ mig ni mi 'dzus sems 'gog dang / /rlud 'gag pa ni dpal ldan bla mas rtogs/ /gang tshe rlud rgyu de ni mi g.yo ste/ /'chi ba'i tshe na rnal 'byor mas ci bya/ /zhes bla ma'i man ngag gi spros pa spangs nas/ rlung g.yo med du byas pa kho nas 'byung ba thim rim 'chi ba ji lta ba bzhin dang / 'od gsal bde ba chen po 'dren nus pa de'i tshe/ rnal 'byor ma ste las kyi phyag rgya ci zhig bya zhes pa'o/ /phyag rgya chen po ma hā ma ya'i ste sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i don rnam bcas la ni sgyu lus kyi rang bzhin/ dpe bcu gnyis kyis mtshon pa'i lha mor snang ba dang / rnam med kyi phyogs la stong pa nyid kyis thams cad sprul pa'i phyir sgyu 'phrul chen mo ste/ de la rtag tu 'byud pa ste bde stong sbyor bas bsgoms shing / rigs ngan ha ḍi ba zhes rang la bos pa'o/ /bcu pa ni/ rtog ge ste dpe dang gtan tshigs kyi sgo nas rjes dpag tshad mas nges pa'i stong nyid du 'dzin pa'i shes rab ni stong nyid sdig bcas dang bu —32—

mo ste las rgya las thob pa'i bde ba'ang bde ba sdig pa can no/ khu zhes pa ni nyams nga ba'i tshig go 'dir sdig pa dang bcas pa'i don ni/ rang bzhin dge ba la sgrib pa'i don yin la/ las dang po pa'i gnas skabs su ni thabs su gyur pa'ang yod pas gong du bshad pa ni lam mthon po'i dbang du byas pa'i nges don yin no/ /rang gi lus la sngar bshad pa ltar goms par byas pas/ gnas la sogs pa sa bcu la bzhugs pa'i lha mo ste pho nya mo rnams kyis 'du ba khyad par can gyi bde ba ster bas lus nyid zhing mchog yin te/ bram ze chen pos/ zhing kun gnas dang nyer ba'i gnas la sogs/ /phyin te bltas pas rtogs par gang smra ba/ /lus dang 'dra ba'i mu gnas g.yin na med/ /dge ba nga yis nges par yang dag mthong / zhes gsungs so/ /de bas na/ de kho na nyid med par yul sna tshogs pa kun dag tu phyin pas thang chad na phung po sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin la sdug bsngal ster ba'i sdig pa brtsams pas de kho na nyid la sgrib pa mtshams med dang 'dra ba ma byed cig /rang la bde chen thog ma nyid nas yod pas bde ba can zhes sems can rnams la bos pa ste/ ha ḍi bas man ngag rtogs nas jo gi kun la smras pa'o/ /de ltar yang / nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i dbye ba yis/ /gnas sogs 'di kho na la gnas/ /de bas de ru bskor ba yis/ /skyo bya de nyid can gyis min/ /zhes dang / gal te de nyid ldan gyur na/ /de rnams bskor ba ci zhig dgos/ /phyi rol rnal 'byor pa de rnams/ /bskor bas khams rnams zad par 'gyur/ /de bas phyi rol spangs nas ni/ /rnal 'byor rol pas gnas par bya/ /dpal ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /rnam dag ye shes sbyan rnams —33—
